summary: Keep operator replication replay available after torn audit writes and record aborted replays on unwind

replay.detail: The explicit graph replay and its writer ownership are unchanged.

schema.detail: The existing local audit JSONL format is unchanged. Malformed records are preserved and skipped with a warning; appends separate an unfinished trailing record with a newline.

rules.detail: Audit history is diagnostic rather than graph replay input; malformed historical records do not prevent maintenance.

compatibility.detail: No peer or client wire changes.

downtime.detail: Confirmed replay still requires a planned window and holds the writer throughout.

manual.detail: A torn audit append no longer requires hand-editing before the estimate or replay command works.

recovery.detail: A drop guard best-effort appends an aborted terminal audit record with operator, start time and elapsed duration when replay unwinds before recording completion. It cannot cover process termination or an unwritable audit file.
